Then give me back those days again when I myself was still unfinished, when an endless fountain of songs welled from my soul, when the world to me was veiled in mystery, when each bud was a miracle of promise as I went out to pick the thousand flowers that thronged the valley. I had nothing then, but it was enough— the yearning for truth and the joy of illusion. Give back to me each reckless longing, the deep and anguished happiness, the strength of hate, the power of love! Oh, give me back my youth again!

@@U00029@@
Youth, old friend, is what you'll need when enemies threaten in the heat of battle, when pretty girls throw their arms around you and squeeze for all they're worth, when in the distance the victory wreath beckons from the hard-won goal, when after the whirl of the frenzied dance you drink away the night. But to strike the familiar strings boldly yet gracefully, to wander leisurely life’s sweet digressions to a self-set goal, that, old friend, is your duty, and we honor you no less for it. Age doesn’t make us childish, as they say, it only finds the child that’s with us still.

@@U00031@@

@@U00027@@
然后让我再次回到那些日子，那时我自己还没有完成，当无尽的歌曲喷泉从我的灵魂中涌出时，当我的世界被神秘的面纱笼罩时，当我出去采摘山谷里的一千朵鲜花时，每个花蕾都是一个承诺的奇迹。那时我一无所有，但已经足够了——对真理的向往和幻想的快乐。还给我每一个不计后果的渴望，深深而痛苦的幸福，恨的力量，爱的力量！哦，让我再次青春吧！

@@U00029@@
老朋友，当敌人在激烈的战斗中威胁时，当漂亮的女孩张开双臂拥抱你时，当远处胜利的花环在来之不易的目标上招手时，当你在疯狂的舞蹈之后喝掉夜晚时，老朋友，你需要的是青春。但是，大胆而优雅地弹奏熟悉的琴弦，在悠闲的生活中漫步，走向自我设定的目标，这是你的责任，老朋友，我们也因此向你致敬。正如人们所说，年龄不会让我们变得幼稚，它只会发现仍然和我们在一起的孩子。

@@U00031@@
